notes: Chilled water plant point dictionary (reference ch.13, CHW-0001..053). Owning equipment: brick:Chiller / brick:Chilled_Water_Loop (both verified in Brick 1.4.4). Plant-level rules: on multi-chiller plants, bind kW/tons/load per chiller instance and the loop temperatures/setpoints per loop. The reference expresses chiller output in tons; the dictionary keeps that unit so the kW/ton quantity matches the trade convention (1 ton = 3.517 kW thermal — conversion belongs at binding, not in the graph).

points.name: chiller_kw

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Chiller via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Active_Power_Sensor grep-verified (same mapping as hp elec_power), isPointOf brick:Chiller (verified). Consumed by CHW-0001's kW/ton numerator.

points.name: chiller_tons

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Chiller via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Thermal_Power_Sensor grep-verified, but marked provisional for the unit: the reference (and the kW/ton convention) uses refrigeration tons while most BAS trend kW thermal or derive tons from flow x deltaT. Binding must land on tons (1 ton = 3.517 kW) or CHW-0001's kW/ton and its baseline coefficients are silently wrong together. Often a host-derived point (flow x deltaT x cp).

points.name: cwst

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the condenser water leaving connection point

points.notes: brick:Leaving_Condenser_Water_Temperature_Sensor grep-verified. Reference Haystack markers: condenser, water, leaving, temp, sensor. Baseline regressor input for CHW-0001 (condenser lift proxy). LOOP-SIDE WARNING: this is the WARM side (chiller-leaving, chiller-to-tower). A future cooling-tower approach rule needs the COLD side (tower-leaving, tower-to-chiller = entering condenser water) — a different point; do not wire a tower rule here by name alone (internal deep-read finding, 2026-08-18).

points.name: chwst

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the CHW leaving connection point

points.notes: brick:Leaving_Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor grep-verified. Consumed by CHW-0001 (baseline regressor) and CHW-0004 (delta-T).

points.name: chwrt

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the CHW entering connection point

points.notes: brick:Entering_Chilled_Water_Temperature_Sensor grep-verified — 'return' at the plant is 'entering' at the chiller; Brick 1.4.4 also carries Chilled_Water_Return_Temperature_Sensor, but the entering-form matches the chiller-owned binding these rules assume. Consumed by CHW-0004.

points.name: chiller_load
points.description: Chiller load (percent of capacity, from the chiller controller)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the Chiller via hasProperty

points.notes: Brick 1.4.4 has no chiller-percent-load class (defrost_status precedent for a null mapping). Typical sources: the chiller's own RLA%/load output, or host-derived tons/design_tons. Evaluability floor for CHW-0001 (30%) and CHW-0004 (40%); range regressor for CHW-0002.

points.name: chwst_sp

s223.pattern: QuantifiableActuatableProperty on the CHW loop via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Leaving_Chilled_Water_Temperature_Setpoint grep-verified. CHW-0002 watches this point's RANGE over the evaluation window — the reset detector reads the setpoint, never the measured temperature (AHU-0023 sat_sp precedent).

points.name: dp_sp

s223.pattern: QuantifiableActuatableProperty on the CHW loop via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Chilled_Water_Differential_Pressure_Setpoint grep-verified. CHW-0003 watches this point's range (AHU-0024 dsp_sp precedent).

points.name: chw_valve_max
points.description: Maximum CHW coil valve position across served coils (host-derived)

s223.pattern: host-derived aggregate; no single physical point

points.notes: HOST-DERIVED (zone_reheat_fraction / satisfied_zone_fraction precedent): the reference's chw_valve_positions is a vector across AHU/FCU cooling coils; the rule needs only its max, so the host binds max() over the coil valve commands it serves. CHW-0003's 'no coil starving' conjunct. Engine vector blocks could compute this in-graph once the points contract grows vector bindings (tracked in internal engine-block-inventory research notes).

points.name: cond_sat_temp
points.description: Condensing saturation temperature (HOST-DERIVED: discharge/liquid pressure via refrigerant P-T lookup)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the equipment via hasProperty

points.notes: Host-derived P-T saturation lookup from measured discharge/liquid pressure (hp dict precedent, duplicated per the lint's own-family resolution rule). Consumed by CHW-0005 condenser-approach-high: approach = cond_sat_temp − cwst. Refrigerant-specific lookup is the host's, documented per binding.

points.name: evap_sat_temp
points.description: Evaporating saturation temperature (HOST-DERIVED: suction pressure via refrigerant P-T lookup, or coil-surface proxy)

s223.pattern: QuantifiableObservableProperty on the equipment via hasProperty

points.notes: Mirror of the hp dict entry (duplicated per the lint's own-family resolution rule; same refrigerant P-T host obligation — the lookup is refrigerant-specific and lives at the host). CHW-0006 evaporator approach = chwst − evap_sat_temp; healthy approach is small and positive, and tube fouling or low charge widens it.
